legal.template: Template for owner review — not legal advice. Have local counsel review this text before launch.
legal.privacyIntro: We collect account details you provide to operate your account and keep it secure.
legal.privacyAccounts: Account email, optional name, language preference, verification status, and consent version are stored in the account database. Passwords are stored only as one-way hashes.
legal.privacyLogs: Security and audit logs may include request identifiers, IP address, user agent, and administrative actions. Never send passwords or authentication tokens in support requests.
legal.privacyRetention: Account records are kept while the account is active. When you delete your account, we anonymize its profile, remove favorites, and revoke active sessions. Operational logs are retained only as long as needed for security and legal obligations.
legal.privacyRights: Contact the business to request access or correction. You can delete your account from account settings after signing in.
legal.termsBody: Property information is provided for general guidance and may change. Verify availability, location, and all transaction details directly with the broker before making a decision. Creating an account does not create a brokerage, agency, or transaction agreement.
legal.cookiesBody: Essential cookies support authentication and security. Optional analytics and marketing cookies are disabled until you consent. Your choice is stored for up to 12 months and can be changed at any time using Cookie settings in the footer.
legal.disclaimer: Listings are informational and subject to change. Please verify details before making a decision.
